title: Advanced Financial Analysis
overview: This course integrates the core aspects of financial statement analysis to enhance participants' ability to evaluate business performance, assess financial health, and identify risks facing businesses and investors. Participants will gain the skills and technical knowledge necessary to ask insightful questions, critique financial data, and confidently analyze business activities. The course applies theory and techniques through interactive examples and case studies, emphasizing practical, hands-on learning.
audience: This course is ideal for chief accountants, senior accountants, finance managers, financial analysts, credit controllers, bankers, corporate financiers, and professionals responsible for financial and credit risk analysis.
methodology: The course combines interactive teaching methods, including expert-led presentations, group exercises, and Excel-based case studies. Participants will apply newly acquired knowledge and present their findings to solidify their understanding.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify and distinguish between the critical components of financial statements.
Analyze financial statement ratios, utilizing Excel to create spreadsheets and graphs.
Detect creative accounting practices and evaluate the validity of accounting rules applied.
Assess the quality of financial reports, focusing on earnings and cash flow reliability.
Evaluate a company's financial performance over time to draw insights about sustainability.
